inventory.services module

inventory.services.aplicar_snapshot_al_periodo_activo(user, snapshot_id)[fuente]

Applies an existing snapshot as the opening balance for the active period.

Parámetros:

  • user – User instance applying the snapshot.

  • snapshot_id – ID of the InventoryPeriodSnapshot to apply.

Devuelve:

dict with counts: - ini_movements: number of created INI movements - lot_items: number of lots reconstructed - products: number of product-location combinations - cleaned_lotstock: lots deleted from previous period - zeroed_inventory: inventories reset to zero

Raises:

InventoryConfig.DoesNotExist or InventoryPeriodSnapshot.DoesNotExist

inventory.services.cerrar_periodo_snapshot(user, cfg_id)[fuente]

Performs the real accounting closure of the active inventory period.

Parámetros:

  • user – User instance performing the closure.

  • cfg_id – ID of the active InventoryConfig to close.

Devuelve:

dict containing: - snapshot_id (int) - items (int): number of items in snapshot - cutoff_ts (datetime): closure timestamp - status (“ok”)

Raises:

InventoryConfig.DoesNotExist if the active config does not exist.

inventory.services.construir_snapshot_desde_movimientos_periodo(user, prev_cfg)[fuente]

Builds a snapshot from the previous period’s movements if none exists.

Parámetros:

  • user – User performing the operation.

  • prev_cfg (InventoryConfig) – Previous InventoryConfig to analyze.

Devuelve:

Created InventoryPeriodSnapshot instance, or None if no positive balances.

Raises:

ValueError for inconsistent or missing data.

Tipo del valor devuelto:

InventoryPeriodSnapshot | None

inventory.services.get_active_period()[fuente]

Retrieves the currently active inventory period.

Devuelve:

InventoryConfig instance if active period exists, otherwise None.

inventory.services.get_previous_period(current_cfg)[fuente]

Retrieves the most recent closed inventory period, excluding the current one.

Parámetros:

current_cfg (InventoryConfig) – The current InventoryConfig instance.

Devuelve:

The last closed InventoryConfig or None.
